summary: Verified iteration_14 follow-up bug batch (cart qty typing, quick-order per-variant offers, admin order prev-pricing note) end-to-end on the live preview. All 3 features PASS. (1) CART QTY EDITABLE: Logged in as customer via API+localStorage (dev_otp), added MASTOBLISS-TSC 500g via Quick Order, opened /cart. cart-qty-MBT-500 input was cleared and typed '12' + Enter -> committed to 12 and Ordered Qty summary updated to 12. Typing '0' + Tab clamped to 1. Empty + Tab committed to 1. cart-plus-{sku} incremented 1->2. cart-minus-{sku} clamped at 1. All assertions passed. (2) QUICK ORDER PER-VARIANT OFFERS: On /quick-order (logged-in customer), each product's variants render as separate rows (qo-row-{vid}). VETKCLOR has 3 rows: 100ml (no chip / '—'), 500ml (chip '5+1'), 1L (no chip). MASTOBLISS-TSC has 2 rows: 500g (chip '30@₹270'), 1Kg (no chip). NERVIPHOS-M shows 30ml and 100ml both without chips. Confirmed each variant renders its OWN qo-offers-{vid} cell that iterates v.active_schemes; the code v.active_schemes.map((o, idx) => ...) supports N chips per variant (visually verified). No variant currently has 2+ schemes in seed data, so the 'multiple chips per row' rendering could not be visually stress-tested, but the code path unambiguously renders all schemes. (3) ADMIN ORDER PREV-PRICING: Logged in admin via API+localStorage; opened /admin/orders; clicked view-order-VM-2026-00021 (eye button) -> order-detail sheet opened; clicked order-edit-pricing -> edit rows appeared; prev-pricing-0 = 'Previously bought @ ₹79' (NERVIPHOS-M 30ml, matches customer_prices), prev-pricing-1 = 'Previously bought @ ₹210' (NERVIPHOS-M 100ml). order-update-pricing checkbox and order-save-pricing button both present. Backend GET /api/admin/orders/{oid}/prev-pricing returned correct {customer_id, prices:{variant_id:{rate,offer,source:'last_confirmed'}}} for that order. Orders with no prior customer_prices (VM-2026-00024 and VM-2026-00020) correctly returned prices:{} and would show no note (verified via direct API call).

issues: Console warning persists: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility'. Non-blocking, carried over from prior iterations.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Wrap SheetContent with VisuallyHidden DialogTitle+Description to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Nice-to-have) Consider seeding a variant with 2+ active_schemes to visually confirm multi-chip rendering in Quick Order.
critical_code_review_comments: Cart QtyCell correctly uses controlled local state with useEffect resync on line.qty change, commits on blur/Enter, and clamps min=1 (Math.max(1, parseInt(val,10) || 1)) which correctly handles '', '0', NaN inputs -> 1. Clean implementation.

QuickOrder Row uses v.active_schemes.map with idx key -> renders ALL schemes as chips. Chip label logic differentiates special_price ('{min}@₹{sp}') from free_qty ('{buy}+{free}'). Correct per-variant offer isolation because Row is instantiated per (p,v) pair via flat.forEach.

AdminOrders.startEdit is async and awaits /admin/orders/{id}/prev-pricing, safely catches errors -> setPrevPricing({}) fallback. prevPricing lookup keyed by variant_id ensures each edit row shows note only when that customer has prior negotiated pricing for THAT specific variant. Backend endpoint filters customer_prices by active:True and $in variant_ids — efficient single query.
prev-pricing note text does not include the offer text when offer.free_quantity is 0/null — correct behaviour.
